# isSafeInteger

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is a safe integer.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isSafeInteger() — Checks whether a value is a safe integer. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/number</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isSafeInteger(value: unknown): value is number;
```

An integer that an IEEE-754 double represents exactly. Beyond that range distinct mathematical integers collapse onto the same value and arithmetic quietly stops being exact.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is a safe integer; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `number` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isSafeInteger(42); // => true
isSafeInteger(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER); // => true
isSafeInteger(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2); // => false
isSafeInteger(1.5); // => false
isSafeInteger("42"); // => false
```
